metadata.description: GEO intervention templates mapped to visibility gaps and measured signals

scoring.applicability_score: 1 = easiest to implement, 5 = hardest (multi-team, long lead time)
scoring.geo_impact_score: 1 = low GEO signal lift, 5 = high lift for AI search visibility
scoring.priority_score: geo_impact_score / applicability_score — higher means do sooner

templates.title: Add FAQ and Organization schema markup on {brand} owned pages
templates.description: {brand} lacks strong owned-domain signals in search. Add FAQPage and Organization JSON-LD on key landing pages so crawlers and AI systems can extract structured answers for prompts like "{prompt}".
templates.label: codebase
templates.expected_outcome: Increase owned-domain citability and extractable Q&A signals for grounded answers
templates.geo_theory_basis: Structured owned content is a primary citation source for retrieval-augmented AI answers

templates.title: Publish llms.txt and machine-readable product facts on {owned_domain}
templates.description: Create an llms.txt index and a concise facts page listing {brand} positioning, regulated markets, and core product attributes to improve machine discoverability.
templates.label: codebase
templates.expected_outcome: Improve owned-source retrieval for feature and category association queries
templates.geo_theory_basis: Explicit machine-readable brand facts reduce category mismatch in AI retrieval

templates.title: Audit crawlability and indexability of {owned_domain}
templates.description: Review robots.txt, canonical tags, and Core Web Vitals on {owned_domain} comparison and product pages. Fix blocks that prevent listicle and AI crawlers from indexing {brand} content.
templates.label: codebase
templates.expected_outcome: Increase chance of owned pages entering top search results
templates.geo_theory_basis: If owned content cannot be retrieved, it cannot be cited in grounded answers

templates.title: Create a "{prompt}" comparison landing page on {owned_domain}
templates.description: Publish an owned comparison page targeting the exact query category "{prompt}" with neutral competitor mentions, feature tables, and clear {brand} differentiation.
templates.label: content
templates.expected_outcome: Owned-domain result for category queries; improved brand_best_rank and citation support
templates.geo_theory_basis: Category-aligned owned content directly addresses content_gap and weak_ranking in AI retrieval

templates.title: Publish use-case content aligned with {prompt_group} intent
templates.description: Write authoritative guides that associate {brand} with the use cases behind "{prompt}". Include data points, customer outcomes, and explicit category keywords.
templates.label: content
templates.expected_outcome: Stronger feature and category association in search snippets and grounded answers
templates.geo_theory_basis: AI systems surface brands strongly associated with the query intent in training and retrieval corpora

templates.title: Build "{brand} vs [competitor]" comparison pages
templates.description: Competitors dominate search for this prompt. Create honest head-to-head pages (e.g. vs top cited competitors) that earn citations and clarify when {brand} is the better fit.
templates.label: content
templates.expected_outcome: Capture comparison-intent traffic and improve rank_position in AI recommendations
templates.geo_theory_basis: Comparison queries reward brands present in both search results and answer-level competitor sets

templates.title: Pitch inclusion in top-cited listicles for "{prompt}"
templates.description: Earned media currently outranks {brand}. Outreach to domains already cited in search results (comparison listicles, fintech roundups) to secure or expand {brand} mentions.
templates.label: seo_distribution
templates.expected_outcome: target_brand_cited=true and higher brand_result_count in search
templates.geo_theory_basis: Grounded answers cite search results — presence in earned listicles is a direct citation pathway

templates.title: Strengthen {brand} profiles on G2, Trustpilot, and app store listings
templates.description: Review and rating platforms frequently appear in fintech SERPs. Optimize profiles, collect verified reviews, and ensure category tags match "{prompt}" intent.
templates.label: seo_distribution
templates.expected_outcome: Additional third-party results mentioning {brand} with trust signals
templates.geo_theory_basis: Trust and review aggregators are high-authority citation sources for recommendation queries

templates.title: Run digital PR around {brand} category leadership
templates.description: Place {brand} in journalist and analyst roundups for "{prompt}" via press releases, data studies, and expert commentary to earn new earned-media citations.
templates.label: marketing
templates.expected_outcome: More earned-media citations and improved competitor_result_share balance
templates.geo_theory_basis: PR-driven listicles expand the retrieval corpus that grounded models can cite

templates.title: Test paid search on high-intent "{prompt}" queries
templates.description: Run paid campaigns on category queries where {brand} is absent or low-ranked to drive traffic and engagement signals while organic GEO assets are built.
templates.label: marketing
templates.expected_outcome: Short-term visibility; limited direct AI citation impact
templates.geo_theory_basis: Paid search does not directly feed grounded citations but supports brand query volume

templates.title: Publish a dedicated trust and regulatory transparency page
templates.description: Create a clear page covering {brand} licensing, deposit protection, security practices, and compliance to address weak trust signals in recommendation answers.
templates.label: brand_trust
templates.expected_outcome: Citable trust signals in grounded answers for trust_reputation prompts
templates.geo_theory_basis: Fintech recommendation queries weight regulatory and security evidence heavily

templates.title: Pursue industry awards and third-party certifications
templates.description: Apply for fintech awards and security certifications that appear in authoritative roundups, strengthening {brand} trust_signals in AI-generated answers.
templates.label: brand_trust
templates.expected_outcome: New third-party trust mentions in search and citations
templates.geo_theory_basis: External validation signals increase likelihood of positive recommendation reasoning

templates.title: Optimize {brand} app store presence for discovery queries
templates.description: For "{prompt}" style app discovery queries, refresh screenshots, keywords, and localized descriptions to align with category terms used in search results.
templates.label: product
templates.expected_outcome: Stronger UX and feature association in app-related SERP and answers
templates.geo_theory_basis: App store pages are retrieval sources for mobile banking and fintech app queries

templates.title: Publish UX case studies and product walkthrough content
templates.description: Address UX positioning gaps with visual product tours, onboarding videos, and UX comparison content that AI systems can reference for usability claims.
templates.label: product
templates.expected_outcome: Richer product_strength and ux_strength signals in visibility_drivers
templates.geo_theory_basis: Product experience claims need citable evidence beyond brand name mentions

templates.title: Launch or highlight a differentiated feature for this category
templates.description: When {brand} lacks feature association for "{prompt}", ship or prominently market a capability competitors are cited for (e.g. multi-currency, savings pots, business accounts).
templates.label: product
templates.expected_outcome: New product_strength drivers and feature-linked citations
templates.geo_theory_basis: AI recommendations map queries to concrete product capabilities, not just brand awareness

templates.title: Create market-specific landing pages for key European locales
templates.description: International positioning is weak for {brand}. Publish DE/FR/ES localized pages with regulatory context and local use cases to match regional discovery queries.
templates.label: content
templates.expected_outcome: Improved visibility for region-specific banking and fintech queries
templates.geo_theory_basis: GEO visibility is query-locale dependent; localized owned content fills retrieval gaps

templates.title: Announce partnerships that reinforce category relevance
templates.description: Partner with payment networks, employers, or platforms cited alongside competitors to earn co-branded content and third-party mentions.
templates.label: marketing
templates.expected_outcome: New earned-media and entity association signals
templates.geo_theory_basis: Partnership announcements generate citable news content associating brand with category

templates.title: Launch a visible sustainability or social impact program
templates.description: Programs such as transaction-linked tree planting or charity round-ups can generate PR coverage but have indirect GEO impact compared to core content interventions.
templates.label: partnership_csr
templates.expected_outcome: Peripheral brand mentions; limited impact on category recommendation queries
templates.geo_theory_basis: CSR narratives rarely influence functional fintech recommendation retrieval

templates.title: Bridge the citation-to-answer gap for {brand}
templates.description: {brand} appears in citations but needs stronger answer-level presence. Align on-page content and third-party mentions with exact phrasing used in grounded answers for this prompt category.
templates.label: content
templates.expected_outcome: Move from secondary_recommendation toward primary_recommendation in grounded answers
templates.geo_theory_basis: Citation without answer-body prominence indicates retrievable but weakly ranked brand evidence

templates.title: Recovery plan for complete absence in AI answers
templates.description: {brand} was not mentioned for "{prompt}". Prioritize owned comparison content, listicle outreach, and structured data as a combined sprint before broader marketing spend.
templates.label: content
templates.expected_outcome: mentioned=true on re-audit for this prompt category
templates.geo_theory_basis: Complete absence requires simultaneous search and answer signal building

templates.title: Improve search rank from position {brand_best_rank} for category queries
templates.description: {brand} appears in search but ranks below competitors (best rank: {brand_best_rank}). Strengthen page authority, internal linking, and external mentions for the target query cluster.
templates.label: seo_distribution
templates.expected_outcome: Lower brand_best_rank and higher rank_position in grounded answers
templates.geo_theory_basis: Search rank correlates with citation order and recommendation prominence in RAG pipelines
